concept:
Create a production UI concept reference board for the existing Chinese Android mobile app VirtuGene. Three coordinated FULL phone screens, each with the SAME 390x844 aspect ratio, laid side by side on a plain charcoal canvas. Label outside phones only: 聊天 / 频道 / 基因库. No phone hardware, no marketing hero, no invented product claims. This is a visual spec to implement as real React DOM, NOT a screenshot to ship. Cinematic photographic environment, broad carefully layered translucent glass, crisp text, conventional mobile density, coherent colors #10151D #181F29 #F2F0EB #B8C2CE #B6C9E2. iOS inspired thin optical edges and tinted depth, not opaque flat boxes or all-over white blur. All text and line icons will be code-native in implementation.
Screen 1: real phone chat. Header back icon, circular character avatar, name 星遥 and small identity 陪伴聊天, phone icon and settings icon. NO analysis orb, emotion score, relationship meter, or memory notification. Behind messages a realistic inhabited cafe window seat at dusk: long perspective, worn oak, linen, low angled light, simple clear central zone. Only 3 short messages: 今天想坐一会儿。 / 好，我在。慢慢说。 / 窗外的光很好看。 Stable legible high-opacity neutral reply bubbles, slightly blue user bubble. Header and bottom input island are more translucent optical glass with fine top edge and background color transmission, NO text distortion. Bottom: plus, large 发消息… field, send icon. Comfortable 16px-equivalent Chinese text.
Screen 2: Messages directory with title 消息, search field 搜索对话, a single glass segmented channel strip 全部 / 对话 / 群聊 / 助理 with elongated selected substrate. Realistic compact rows with avatar, name, timestamp and recent line, no fake metrics. Names 星遥 / 林霜 / 周末小聚. Bottom navigation exactly 消息 / 世界 / 角色 / 我的 using clearly different line icons, selected glass substrate. Include a small separate four-frame microdiagram UNDER or beside this screen showing the selected substrate at rest, stretched while dragging, released, reversed; the labels do not stretch.
Screen 3: gene library title 基因库 and subtitle 发现与创造角色. Search field 搜索名字、性格…, small 融合 control. Sources 全部 / 预设 / 共享 / 我的. Discreet category filters. Main A-Z portrait glass horizontal cards 104px natural height, 64x80 portrait image, 16px name, 13px signature, max2 tags, small source and 已添加 state kept separate. Show 4 clearly readable roles 星遥 / 林霜 / 顾策 / 晓来. No chevron on each row, no giant banner, no DNA spinning equipment. Cards have tinted material substrate, fine rim and shadow; content remains sharp. No main-screen emotion or private memories. Include realistic loaded, selected and one disabled visual state across the board without inventing app features. All three screens must share typography, optical edges, spacing rhythm and purposeful glass. Make it beautiful but realistically implementable with existing CSS gradients, pseudo-elements, stable DOM reading surfaces, isolated background layers and small local particles.
dusk: Production background asset for VirtuGene mobile chat, full portrait 9:20 composition at native output resolution. Photographic cinematic interior, clear material detail, realistic lived-in city cafe window seat at dusk. Eye level camera, a tall black bronze framed window occupies right 60% from top to around 63% height; urban trees and rooftops outside under a dusky pink blue sky, no distant planet. Left 25% warm painted wall and one modest shaded lamp, a worn linen chair left/bottom behind a diagonally receding oak table in lower quarter. On the table lower left is exactly one small ceramic cup on a saucer at approximately x=.24 y=.79, a closed paperback near lower right, a few stems in a simple vase on far left. No symmetrical staged decor. Gentle low-angle warm sunlight and local lamp, clear glass reflection and thin window rim. Central upper and mid area quiet enough to layer code-native messages but do NOT add any UI, text, people, portrait, phone frame, logo or watermark. Highly believable used wood, woven linen, glass and matte plaster with natural imperfections, not oversharpened, no painterly render or plastic sheen, no artificial RGB aurora, no heavy bokeh or blur. Use the same restrained mood and window-seat perspective as the cafe in the left screen of the reference concept. This image will be the fixed master composition for a later night-weather edit, so keep stable readable architectural boundaries and do not include rain yet.
rainNight: Edit this exact cafe photograph into the RAINY NIGHT lighting variant of the same mobile chat room. Preserve camera framing, image aspect, all window mullions, furniture edges, chair, oak table, one cup and saucer, closed book, flowers and lamp in their EXACT original positions and shape. No object substitutions, no zoom, no moving architecture, no extra cups. Change ONLY time, weather, light: sky now deep blue after nightfall, city lights naturally lit without fantasy neon, warm lamp illuminating the same worn wood and linen, light rain seen outside and restrained fine water on glass. Preserve sharp textile and timber detail, subtle realistic lamp reflection, not overly glossy, no blanket blur, no RGB. The output must align pixel for pixel in scene geometry with the original so they can crossfade without furniture melting. No UI/text/people/logos/watermarks. The actual app will render dynamic rain behind the window mask, so do not bake large dominating rain streaks; a few small realistic moisture highlights are sufficient.
note: Three calls: one design board, one master, one same-composition night edit. No runtime model dependency.
